# FAQ-015 Engineering FAQ #15

Revision: Rev A

Q1: What is the allowable quench delay for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03)?
A1: The quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) is 13 seconds. Refer to ECN-2026-038 for the approved deviation procedure if a run exceeds this limit.

Q2: What torque is specified for the mandrel clamp bolt on Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L4-RR01)?
A2: The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L4-RR01) is 525 N·m. Use the calibrated torque wrench procedure in SOP-P1-L3-05 when performing this task.

Q3: What is the minimum coil cooling water flow for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01)?
A3: The coil cooling water flow minimum for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 79 L/min. See MM-P1-L2-HT03 for monitoring locations and alarm setpoints.

Q4: What austenitizing setpoint should be used for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03)?
A4: The austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) is 855 °C. Verify control loop configuration per ECN-2026-038 when updating setpoints.

Q5: What torque is specified for the mandrel clamp bolt on Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03)?
A5: The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03) is 620 N·m. Record torque values in the maintenance log and follow SOP-P1-L3-05 for re-torque procedures.

Related documents:
- ECN-2026-038
- MM-P1-L2-HT03
- SOP-P1-L3-05
